$comment: Config for the loop pipeline (LOOP-ARCHITECTURE.md). Structure only — NEVER secret values. Bootstrapped 2026-07-02; committed 2026-08-12 (previously untracked, so the loops' source of truth existed only in one machine's working tree). Flat shape (no profiles{}) = single-stream repo: the loops run bare with no stream suffix.

git.$worktree_root_note: Intentionally omitted: it was an absolute path under one developer's home dir, which cannot be correct for anyone else. The loops resolve worktrees relative to the checkout, matching the sibling repos (tzp-3plc, tzp-tiktok), which track no worktree_root either.

ephemeral_recipe.up: container run -d --name <name> -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=<pw> -e POSTGRES_USER=<user> -e POSTGRES_DB=<db> -p <hostport>:5432 docker.io/library/postgres:17-alpine
ephemeral_recipe.hostport_strategy: pick a free high port per item (e.g. 5+random) to avoid collisions across concurrent units

db.note: Ephemeral local Postgres via Apple's `container` runtime (container v1.0.0), NOT Docker — the Docker daemon is not used on this machine. `-p <hostport>:5432` publishes to 127.0.0.1 so DATABASE_URL points at localhost. Verified end-to-end 2026-07-02: host psql -> 127.0.0.1 -> conn-ok, PostgreSQL 17.10. Spun up per-item and torn down. `container system status` must be running; DB-touching items park only if it is not. The container also has a routable IP (192.168.64.x) if localhost publish ever fails.

_bootstrap_notes: Status labels mapped from this workspace's custom statuses (no native In-Review/Needs-Info labels existed): review_status=update required, blocked/ambiguous=on hold, done=complete. Chosen unattended on 2026-07-02 with defaults; adjust if wrong. (The build/lint/typecheck/test scripts above were aspirational at bootstrap, pending item 86e24cy2d — that scaffolding has since landed and every command is real and passing as of 2026-08-12.) queue.transport set to "cli" on 2026-08-14 after the MCP ClickUp transport hit a multi-hour rate limit mid-session (several rounds blocked on reads); the `cup` CLI was confirmed reachable and answering the same queries throughout, so every queue operation now goes through `cup` instead of mcp__claude_ai_ClickUp__* tools. merge_policy set to "auto-on-pass-safe" on 2026-08-29 (Principle 4c) after a 30-PR reviewed-pass backlog piled up at the human merge gate with no policy set (absent defaults to "human"); Review's PASS verdict now auto-merges a unit only when every item is S/M appetite, unflagged (no rabbit-hole/solo-risk flag), and CI is fully green — anything else still lands in the manual merge-order table.
